description: This PHP source file defines the InstallationDatabaseAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for creating a database during the installation process of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract REST controller and handles POST requests to trigger database creation, catching invalid argument exceptions and setting HTTP response status accordingly.

classes.name: InstallationDatabaseAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class responsible for handling database installation requests via POST, creating a new database through AppSetupUtility, and managing error responses.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a database by invoking AppSetupUtility and managing possible InvalidArgumentException errors. Returns an error message and sets HTTP status code if exception occurs; otherwise, returns an empty array.
